F1.evidence: No declared per-hue ramp exists on the main surfaces — styled-components compiles Calm's theme into literals, so measured roles emit under core.color.neutral/brand/app. The only declared ramp is the Zendesk Garden --zd-* layer on /faq/web (blue, green, grey, red, kale and friends at real steps), emitted under core.zd.color.*.

F2.evidence: Measured page/field surfaces in light (surface.page #f6f6f7, surface.field, the navy header scrim and the white auth-card backdrop) and a dark layer built from painted roles only (surface.page = the scene gradient's deep stop, surface.rail black@30%, surface.pill/active/raised from the tab and top-bar pills).

F3.evidence: Measured text roles in light (on-paper ink, muted, faint, link, hero text, text-on-action) and dark (text.primary, text.muted, text.on.active for the white selected pill). Disabled is absent — no disabled control paints on the signed-out surface.

F4.evidence: The black@8% hairline (neutral.hairline), the content-tile border (measured.card-border #000000) and the painted 1px focus ring (measured.focus-ring) are measured; no strong-border role paints signed out.

F5.evidence: The header CTA (nav-cta), hero CTA, dark login and signup pills, tabs and rail items were all measured at default/hover/focus-visible/CDP-pressed; the tab gains its white fill on selected (tab-active vs tab).

F6.evidence: No status surface paints on the signed-out routes; the only status palette is the declared Garden --zd-* green/red families on the help center, emitted under core.zd.color.

F7.evidence: Both surfaces are genuinely painted and tokenised (light ~20 leaves, dark ~10), but they are different products, not a theme toggle — the dark set carries no border/link roles to mirror light's, and roles that exist on one surface were never painted on the other.

F8.evidence: Figtree serves in 6 weights/styles from the Next.js bundle and runs every measured surface (ITC Souvenir and Neue Plak are served but paint nowhere); a measured 12-step ramp emits under core.font.size (display through health-display) with weights and the measured display/h2 line heights.

F9.evidence: No declared spacing scale exists — every gap/height is a measured literal; control/tab/header/banner/signup-bar heights and rail widths emit under component.* and the Garden --zd-spacing-* steps emit under core.zd.spacing.

F10.evidence: Seven measured radii emit under core.radius: the fully-rounded pill, tab, tile, rail-item, login card, badge and mobile menu button; a 1px focus-ring width is measured.

F11.evidence: Control heights are measured (56px pills, 48px rail items and search link, 26px tabs, 64/100px headers, 92px signup bar) and the 1px/0px-offset focus ring is captured; only one control size paints per role and icon sizes are limited to the measured 18px social icons and 32px carousel arrows.

F12.evidence: Two measured elevations emit under core.shadow: the B2B card's 0 2px 12px black@8% lift and the auth card's 0 8px 24px black@25% over the scrim; every other measured box-shadow reads none — Calm genuinely favours fills over shadows.

F13.evidence: Two measured 300ms transitions emit (nav-transition, cta-transition) and the reduced-motion pass is recorded in raw (header transition stays 0.3s ease-out, animation none 0s, scroll-behavior auto); no declared duration/easing layer exists.

F14.evidence: Header heights at both viewports, the 240px app rail, the 300px content-card grid columns and the 1425px fixed header are measured; breakpoints/z-index layers are inferred from the 1440 vs 390 responsive pass, not a declared scale.

C1.evidence: 50 components/130 states measured: buttons (nav/hero/dark/login pills), icon buttons (menu, dialog close, search link, carousel arrows), links, tabs + selected, the full-screen mobile menu, the login dialog, content/health cards, the New badge, rail and rail items, the footer and the consent banner. Text field, select, checkbox, radio, switch, toast, table, avatar and tooltip never paint on the signed-out public surface.

C2.evidence: Every interactive component carries hover, focus-visible and CDP-pressed readings plus default; selected is measured on tab-active and rail-item-active; the opened states (login dialog, mobile menu) are captured as screenshots and measured boxes.

C3.evidence: Focus-visible was captured via real keyboard focus on every interactive component; the painted 1px outline (measured.focus-ring, #101010 on the light nav) is emitted as a token.

C4.evidence: components.md entries carry the measured values with crops and provenance; where a value became a token the entry names it, but the bulk of spec lines are raw measured literals because Calm declares no token layer to alias to.

P1.evidence: patterns.md covers the public architecture: the scrim header + hero, the rounded CTA system, the auth card and gated signup flow, the dark preview shell composition (rail/tabs/cards/upsell/signup bars), the B2B surface, the footer and the mobile menu. Forms-and-validation, onboarding and destructive flows do not exist on the signed-out surface and are documented as boundaries.

A1.evidence: Fonts are named with their provenance (Figtree 300–700 plus unused Souvenir/Neue Plak faces, served from the Calm CDN, not distributed; style guide falls back to system sans). Icons were not lifted to a standalone set — the logo, rail glyphs and social icons are visible in crops and screenshots, recorded as a layoutGap.

K1.evidence: The README states what was captured (routes, viewports, signed out, headed-under-Xvfb and why), how every file is generated, the PerimeterX retry policy, and a What-to-distrust list including the auth boundary, the gated /signup-flow landing and the two-dates provenance.
